# Session states

Generated by the state test (`go test -run TestStates -update`); do not edit.

## Axes

- **presence**: in-calendar, removed
- **status**: tentative, parse_error, unmatched, missing_fee, priced, package, removed
- **client**: matched, none
- **timing**: upcoming, happened
- **record**: none, notes-only, summary
- **fee**: nothing-due, owed
- **payment**: none, paid, waived
- **paid for**: current, outdated
- **bought**: none, due, settled
- **invoice**: empty, draft, issued
- **receipt**: empty, draft, issued
- **drift**: none, drifted

## Rules

| rule | bucket | reason | why | resolved by / guarded by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| deleted | contradiction | deleted | Gone from the calendar, kept for what was recorded on it | sessions.restore, sessions.discard, payments.set, documents.cancel, documents.discardDraft |
| title-unreadable | contradiction | fix | The calendar title can't be read | sessions.update, documents.cancel |
| client-unmatched | contradiction | fix | No client has the name in the title | sessions.update, clients.save, documents.cancel |
| fee-missing | contradiction | fix | No amount in the title, no package credit and no fee set for the client | sessions.update, clients.save, packages.save, documents.cancel |
| tentative-unknown-client | contradiction | fix | Tentative under a name no client has | sessions.update, clients.save, documents.cancel |
| contradicts-document | contradiction | fix | The calendar changed after an invoice or receipt was issued | documents.revise, documents.cancel |
| fee-changed-after-payment | contradiction | fix | The calendar changed the fee after it was paid, and the amount paid doesn't match it; only once the fee is known (confirmed, read and priced) | payments.set, sessions.update, documents.cancel |
| unconfirmed | needs-action | confirm | Still tentative (`?` title) | sessions.update, sessions.delete, documents.cancel |
| unrecorded | needs-action | record | Happened, with no summary written | sessions.saveRecord |
| unpaid | needs-action | collect | Happened, and its fee or the package bought in it is still owed | payments.set |
| removed-status-mismatch | impossible |  | Removed exactly when its status says so | by construction: the reconcile derives the removed status from the event being gone |
| removed-without-data | impossible |  | A removed session is kept only for what was recorded on it | sessions.saveRecord; attachments.delete; by construction: the reconcile deletes a session gone from the calendar with nothing on it |
| fee-owed-unpriced | impossible |  | Only a priced session owes a fee of its own | by construction: DueCents charges only a priced session |
| drift-without-issued-document | impossible |  | Drift compares the calendar with an issued document | by construction: the reconcile only sets drift against an issued document |
| outdated-without-payment | impossible |  | Only money received can settle an old fee | by construction: Payment.Outdated holds only for a payment received |
| paid-on-credit | impossible |  | A package credit leaves nothing to pay on the session itself | payments.set; by construction: the reconcile gives a paid session its own fee, never a credit |
| receipt-without-payment | impossible |  | A receipt confirms money received | documents.createDraft; payments.set |
